richContent.intro: A request to “fireproof the building” can leave the actual job unclear. [Fireproofing.tv](https://fireproofing.tv/) is a new publication in our network, helping building owners, property managers and renovation teams prepare a more useful conversation before they commission work.

sections.heading: Start with the building question
paragraphs: The site launches with sixteen practical guides. Subjects include spray-applied fire-resistive materials, intumescent finishes, penetration firestopping, damaged protection, project records and the information to gather before requesting an estimate.

The opening guide explains why structural protection, firestopping and fire-resistance-rated assemblies need their own questions. Articles link primary references and keep planning information separate from the project-specific decisions that belong with qualified professionals and the relevant authority.

sections.heading: Bring better information to the next meeting
paragraphs: The [estimate information checklist](https://fireproofing.tv/guides/fireproofing-estimate-information-checklist/) helps owners organise a project conversation. Other guides address records at handover, contractor questions and what needs review when a renovation changes service penetrations.

This is an educational publication. It does not certify a building, choose a rated system, prescribe a product thickness or provide safety-critical installation instructions. The useful next step is a clearer brief and a named professional review path.

sections.heading: A focused resource for the industry
paragraphs: The main site keeps owner guidance first. Footer pages explain [contractor participation](https://fireproofing.tv/for-contractors/) and [guest posting](https://fireproofing.tv/guest-posting/), alongside a route to IAM for business enquiries.

Contractor applications and guest submissions are not open at launch. The site does not promise directory placement, approval badges or publication. Future contributions need clear commercial disclosure and supporting primary sources.

sections.heading: Welcome to the network
paragraphs: Fireproofing.tv uses a restrained cream, deep-green and warm-orange identity, with straightforward navigation through the planning library. Its purpose is practical: help a property team understand what needs to be discussed before a quote or renovation decision.
Powered by Industry Army Marketing. A division of BuildersHaus.com.

[Explore Fireproofing.tv](https://fireproofing.tv/) and start with the guide closest to your project question. For branding, websites or industry publishing, follow the footer’s IAM link to discuss your business.
